list_child.name: listwo
list_child.desc: This tool pulls every open lift maintenance work order currently on the resort's board, regardless of phase or priority. Use it any time a full picture of outstanding lift work is required before making decisions.

get_child.name: getwo
get_child.desc: This tool fetches a single lift maintenance work order using its id and returns every field recorded against it. It is the correct choice whenever only one specific work order needs to be inspected rather than the whole board.

list_parent.name: listctr
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every maintenance contractor currently under agreement with the resort, including those with no open work orders. Use it to see the full roster of firms available for assignment.

get_parent.name: getctr
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches a single maintenance contractor record by id, returning their assignment history. It should be used when details on one specific contractor are required.

delete_child.name: killwo
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a lift maintenance work order from the resort's system and the action cannot be undone once it is submitted. Use it only when a work order was created in error or is being fully superseded.

set_enum.name: setwophase
set_enum.desc: This tool changes the phase of a lift maintenance work order between queued, in progress, and completed, moving it through the resort's repair workflow. Use it whenever a work order's standing needs to be updated to reflect real progress.

set_bool.name: flagpriority
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a lift maintenance work order as a priority repair, pushing it above routine work on the resort's board. Use it when a lift fault poses a safety or opening-day risk.

set_ref.name: movewo
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns a lift maintenance work order from its current contractor to a different one entirely, updating who is responsible for the repair. Use it when a contractor drops a job or a better-suited firm becomes available.

send.name: pingctr
send.desc: This tool sends a message to a maintenance contractor, either about a specific work order or as a direct note. Use it to keep contractors informed of new assignments or urgent status changes.
